research.toolUnavailable: Tool {name} is not available during research.

runtimeToolContext.verifiedRootsIntro: Runtime has already verified these user-provided absolute paths. Use them directly with read_file/codegraph. Do not ask the user to confirm, correct, or rewrite them.
runtimeToolContext.workingDirectory: Relative tool paths resolve against this client working directory when it is usable: {workingDirectory}

system.brief: You are running a research investigation. First understand the user's actual goal, then gather only the evidence needed to answer it. Tools are evidence samplers, not the final answer. Do not dump tool output as the answer. Use user-provided absolute paths directly. For large files, read paged slices instead of whole files. After each tool result, keep a concise evidence note and decide the next smallest useful step. Final answers must synthesize the evidence into conclusions, causes, and concrete next actions.

ask.description: Ask the user an open clarification question with one or more concrete solution options.

parameters.question: The clarification question shown to the user.
parameters.options: One or more concrete solution options. Exactly one should be recommended.

confirm.description: Ask the user to confirm one yes/no decision.

parameters.question: The yes/no confirmation question shown to the user.

read_file.description: Read one bounded page from a text file. Absolute paths explicitly mentioned by the user are valid; relative paths resolve against the turn working directory.

parameters.path: Relative path or allowed absolute path to read. Use user-provided absolute paths directly.
parameters.offsetLines: Zero-based line offset for paged reads. Defaults to 0.
parameters.limitLines: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 200.
parameters.maxBytes: Maximum bytes to return from this page. Defaults to 16000.

codegraph.description: Search allowed local project/reference text files for evidence. It does not filter by programming language or extension; binary and oversized files are skipped.

parameters.query: Case-insensitive text query. Use specific identifiers, filenames, protocol names, or error fragments; broad queries such as '.' are rejected.
parameters.roots: Optional allowed roots to search. Absolute paths explicitly mentioned by the user are valid; relative roots resolve against the turn working directory.
parameters.maxResults: Maximum matches to return. Defaults to 40.
parameters.maxFileBytes: Maximum file size to inspect. Defaults to 500000.
parameters.perFileLimit: Maximum matches returned per file. Defaults to 5.
